news.headline: SoftBank Wants to Buy America’s Biggest Security Guard Company and Use Robots
news.summary: SoftBank is eyeing an $18 billion deal to take over the largest private security firm in America, with plans to swap out guards for robots at scale. The math only works if machines can do the job, and that question is far from settled.
